components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The cobalt action that opens the deterministic Sample Inspection.
components.html: Try the sample →
components.css: .button.button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 13px; background: var(--oxide); color: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow-control); font-family: 'Manrope Variable', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: .82rem; font-variation-settings: 'wght' 620; transition: transform 170ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 170ms ease, background-color 170ms ease; } .button.button-primary:hover { background: var(--oxide-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Theme Toggle
components.description: A persistent light/dark environment control present on landing and inspector toolbars.
components.html: <button class='theme-toggle' type='button' aria-label='Switch to dark mode'><svg class='theme-icon theme-icon-sun' aria-hidden='true'></svg></button>
components.css: .theme-toggle { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--ink-soft); box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(31, 42, 68, 0.08); transition: color 180ms ease, transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 180ms ease; } .theme-toggle:hover { color: var(--ink); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); }

components.name: Empty Inspector
components.description: The empty desktop entry state uses direct optical language and keeps local file handling explicit.
components.html:
Bring a PNG or WAV into focus.

Choose one local PNG or WAV, or drop it anywhere in this window.
components.css: .empty-inspector-content { max-width: 720px; padding: clamp(72px, 10vw, 150px) clamp(30px, 8vw, 120px); } .empty-inspector-content h2 { max-width: 12ch; margin: 16px 0 18px; color: var(--ink); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 5.2rem); font-variation-settings: 'wght' 640; letter-spacing: -.04em; }

components.name: Landing Live Inspector
components.description: The perspective sample surface that links a real PNG span to its Structure and Field note.
components.html: Selected Signature
components.css: .sample-plate { position: relative; padding: clamp(22px, 3vw, 36px); border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface-raised); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); transform: perspective(1100px) rotateY(-1.5deg) rotateX(.75deg); } .sample-plate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 22px -16px -18px 22px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--accent-softer); filter: blur(1px); }

components.name: Structure Row
components.description: A semantic source-ordered Structure button tied to an exact Byte span.
components.css: .structure-list .structure-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 53px 1fr; gap: 10px; min-height: 54px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; } .structure-list .structure-row:hover { border-color: var(--rule); background: var(--paper-quiet); } .structure-list .structure-row.is-selected { border-color: rgba(91, 97, 244, .18); background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); }

components.name: Selected Byte Span
components.description: The raw byte cell and its ownership trace for the current Selection.
components.css: .byte-grid .byte-cell { min-height: 44px; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule); background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: .78rem var(--mono); text-align: center; } .byte-grid .byte-cell.is-selected { z-index: 1; background: var(--oxide); color: #fff; outline: 2px solid var(--oxide); outline-offset: -2px; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(65, 71, 215, .30), inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .22); animation: lens-lock 260ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both; }

components.name: Selection Summary
components.description: A persistent text summary that keeps the exact span legible beside the virtualized grid.
components.html: Selected Width, offset 10, length 4 bytes.
components.css: .selection-summary { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; min-height: 58px; margin-top: 32px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(91, 97, 244, .16); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--accent-softer); box-shadow: var(--shadow-inset); } .summary-mark { width: 19px; height: 19px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--oxide); box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgba(65, 71, 215, .22); }

components.name: Field Inspector
components.description: The semantic detail column for a selected Field or Structure.
components.html:

components.css: .field-detail { margin-top: 26px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); } .field-detail h3 { margin: 8px 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .detail-explanation { color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.45; } .field-facts dt { color: var(--ink-soft); font: .6rem var(--mono); text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Mobile Inspector Tabs
components.description: The narrow-screen navigation among Structures, Bytes, and Fields.
components.html: <nav class='narrow-inspector-tabs' role='tablist'><button class='narrow-inspector-tab' role='tab' aria-selected='true'>Structures</button><button class='narrow-inspector-tab' role='tab'>Bytes</button><button class='narrow-inspector-tab' role='tab'>Fields</button></nav>
components.css: .narrow-inspector-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 5px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper-deep); } .narrow-inspector-tab { min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft); font: .67rem var(--mono); text-transform: uppercase; } .narrow-inspector-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--surface-raised); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(31, 42, 68, .08); color: var(--oxide-dark); }

narrative.overview: HexLens is a neutral light/dark optical workspace for connecting raw bytes to the Structures and Fields they support. Manrope carries interface hierarchy and explanation; JetBrains Mono carries measurement. Cobalt identifies the current Selection and action path; jade identifies local/privacy status. Soft offset depth, inset data surfaces, and a slight landing perspective create a calm console hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light and dark lens environments
Manrope interface with JetBrains Mono bytes and data
Cobalt selection with jade local/privacy status
Soft offset depth and inset data surfaces
Three-pane desktop inspection with mobile tabs

rules.name: The Cobalt Selection Rule
rules.body: Cobalt identifies the current semantic path and is paired with labels, outlines, ownership boundaries, or summaries.

rules.name: The Jade Local Rule
rules.body: Jade is reserved for local/privacy, healthy operation, and ownership cues; it is not a second selection color.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: Manrope explains the file and JetBrains Mono measures it.

rules.name: The Immediate Contrast Rule
rules.body: Theme changes swap foreground tokens immediately so dark surfaces never carry light-mode text.

rules.name: The Calibrated Depth Rule
rules.body: Use one clear lift for a coherent surface and inset treatment for data; depth clarifies hierarchy rather than decorating it.

rules.name: The One Span Rule
rules.body: One selected Byte span synchronizes Structure, raw bytes, Field details, and the accessible summary.

dos: Do preserve the local-only promise and deterministic Sample path.
Do keep the desktop three-pane and mobile tab inspection models legible.
Do use cobalt for Selection and jade for local/privacy status.
Do label Source preview as original-file rendering.
donts: Don't reintroduce the replaced warm paper, serif, oxide, verdigris, or paper-and-ink system.
Don't turn the console into terminal chrome or a metric-tile dashboard.
Don't animate foreground text during a theme change.
Don't decode Payload content or present browser rendering as parsed output.
